title: Design System: Tempo Ink Is Movement

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Quiet hover, focus, and active-index changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: remove transform movement while preserving color and state feedback
motion.purpose: Respect reduced-motion preferences without hiding state feedback.

shadows.name: inset
shadows.purpose: Quiet paper depth inside study surfaces and controls.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Small lift for the forward action and selected utility surfaces.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs, drawers, and temporary layers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single indigo forward action in a square editorial control.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A paper-toned reversible action with a fine rule.

components.name: Field
components.description: A labeled paper field with a blue-gray focus line.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: The studio index with small line icons and an indigo active rail.

components.name: Session Row
components.description: A study tile with workout context, metrics, and ink-flow hover state.

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A visible text state for planned, adjusted, or missed work.

components.name: Intensity Timeline
components.description: Duration-proportional workout structure with quiet zone color.

narrative.overview: Tempo is a Monday-first endurance studio rendered on warm paper. Indigo owns actions and active context, blue-gray linework carries the flow, and structured sessions become study tiles without changing the product's operational behavior.

rules.name: The Ink Roles Rule
rules.body: Indigo owns forward action and active context. Blue-gray linework owns focus and flow. Status colors explain what happened; they do not compete with the next action.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Duration, TSS, RPE, dates, and counts are data. Keep their numerals stable and aligned with MetricText.

rules.name: The Paper Depth Rule
rules.body: Inset depth belongs to the paper material. Outer elevation is reserved for overlays and stateful utility surfaces.

dos: Reuse PageShell, TopBar, shared button and field classes, Surface, SessionRow, StatusBadge, MetricText, and SessionBlockBar.
Pair every color state with text, structure, or an accessible label.
Preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, explicit labels, readable contrast, and 44px touch targets.
donts: Do not add route-local primary navigation.
Do not make every bordered region a floating dashboard card.
Do not use color alone for state.
Do not add gradients or extra accent roles to ordinary authenticated product screens.
